title: Projects
summary: Hackathon builds and personal products. Gallery overview — the full archive is one pull away.

items.title: Aprendi
items.blurb: AI educational platform: learning patterns, personalized insights, and interactive Linux labs.
body: Winner (1st place) at the UFM Computer Science Hackathon 2026.
Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, and Supabase. Team of 3; product still evolving.

items.title: Agent Builder
items.blurb: Platform to build and deploy AI agents with LLMs, RAG, and real-time data integration.
body: Awarded / finalist at Atom Dev Day 2026. ~8-hour sprint, team of 3.

items.title: Astro Tracker
items.blurb: Interactive asteroid-impact simulation using NASA APIs, FITS data, and physical/economic damage estimates.
body: 48-hour MVP (team of 6) for NASA Space Apps Challenge.
Node.js, React, Chakra UI, MongoDB, NASA API, FITS visualization, and World Bank data.

items.title: Videntia
items.blurb: AI visual analysis platform that generates human-like image descriptions for accessibility and research.
body: School project featured at Expokinal 2025. Team of 6; ~1-week build.
Node.js, React, Chakra UI, Google Cloud Vision, OpenRouter / LLMs, and computer vision.

items.title: Unmask AI
items.blurb: AI tool using OCR and LLMs to extract and analyze visual data with automated deep search.
body: ~3-day solo MVP. Node.js, React, Tailwind, OCR, LLMs, Google Deep Search / Baidu.
